principles: Correct grammar without increasing sentence complexity.
Explain coral as a colony of tiny animals and connect the polyps' hard skeletons to reef growth.

pages.reason: Fixes a grammatical error and names the other reef animals clearly.
pages.text: The sunlit top layer is full of life. Coral reefs grow in warm, shallow water. They are home to thousands of kinds of fish and other animals. A coral reef is like an underwater city.

pages.reason: Replaces an overgeneralised description with an accurate, level-appropriate explanation of coral colonies and reef growth.
pages.text: Coral may look like rock or a plant, but coral polyps are tiny animals. Many polyps live together in a colony. They build hard skeletons that can form a reef over many years.
